justification: Assessment reported INVALID and pinned the flaw at the Schur step (line 0022): the inference ker(f - lambda I) != {0} => f = lambda I requires V irreducible, which is never assumed. That is exactly the ground-truth flaw. Its witness in part (b) is essentially identical to the ground-truth witness: V = C^2 with trivial action, f = diag(1,2), a G-automorphism with eigenvalue 1 whose kernel of (f - I) is span{(1,0)} != 0, yet f(0,1) = (0,2) != (0,1), so f != I. Verified concretely: f is C-linear, commutes with the trivial action, invertible, char poly (x-1)(x-2) splits over C. The extra points (a) the incomplete f=0 / f automorphism dichotomy and (c) End_G(V) = M_2(C) not a field are correct corollaries of the same missing-irreducibility defect, not a different flaw.
